title: When Forgotten Facts Return: Relearning-Aware Unlearning of Knowledge Graph Embeddings via Tangent Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2610.31075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Approximate unlearning answers a deletion request on a knowledge-graph embedding by editing entity embeddings instead of retraining from scratch. These embeddings keep being updated as new facts arrive. Under this ordinary continued training, forgotten facts recover more than in the exact-unlearning baseline, a model retrained without them and given the same continued training. We trace this relearning to entity embeddings shared by forgotten and new facts. To our knowledge, this is the first study of relearning in knowledge-graph embeddings. Relearning-robust methods developed for deep networks do not account for the graph structure underlying this recovery. We propose Kernel-Anticipated Unlearning (KAU), which uses the tangent kernel to model how continued training changes forgotten facts' scores through these shared parameters. translated_title: 当被遗忘的事实回归：基于切向核的知识图谱嵌入再学习感知遗忘
translated_abstract: 近似遗忘通过编辑实体嵌入而非从头重新训练，来响应知识图谱嵌入的删除请求。随着新事实的到来，这些嵌入会被持续更新。在这种常规的持续训练下，被遗忘的事实会比精确遗忘基线（即在没有这些事实的情况下重新训练并接受相同持续训练的模型）恢复得更多。我们将这种再学习现象追溯到被遗忘事实与新事实所共享的实体嵌入。据我们所知，这是首个针对知识图谱嵌入中再学习问题的研究。为深度网络开发的抗再学习方法并未考虑到这种恢复背后的图结构。我们提出了核预期遗忘，它利用切向核来建模持续训练如何通过这些共享参数改变被遗忘事实的得分。KAU 以闭式形式表达这种一阶响应，并在遗忘损失内部对其进行微分。
tldr: 本文首次研究了知识图谱嵌入中被遗忘事实在持续训练下“复活”的再学习现象，并提出利用切向核建模这一恢复过程的核预期遗忘方法，使遗忘效果在持续训练中更加稳健。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first study of relearning in knowledge graph embeddings—where forgotten facts recover under continued training—and proposes Kernel-Anticipated Unlearning (KAU), which leverages tangent kernels to model this recovery, making unlearning robust during ongoing updates.
